# Elevate Estates

> Real estate brokerage serving Baabda and Mount Lebanon, Lebanon. We list
> apartments, villas, commercial property and land for sale and rent, and
> handle viewings and negotiation directly over WhatsApp.

Every listing carries a reference number in the form `ELV-XX-0000`. Quote it
when enquiring about a specific property.

Contact: +961 71 991 088 (phone and WhatsApp)
Service area: Baabda, Hazmieh, Biyada, Broummana, Antelias, Dbayeh, Jal el Dib,
Mansourieh, Mtayleb, Rabieh and surrounding Mount Lebanon towns.

## Pages

- [Home](https://www.elevateestateslb.com/): Overview, featured listings and property search by area, type and budget.
- [Browse Properties](https://www.elevateestateslb.com/listings.html): Full searchable portfolio, filterable by purpose (sale or rent), property type, area, bedrooms and price.
- [Recently Sold](https://www.elevateestateslb.com/sold.html): Properties already sold or rented through Elevate Estates. These are a closed record and are not available; they are excluded from the browse and search pages.
- [List Your Property](https://www.elevateestateslb.com/submit.html): Submission form for owners and agents wanting to list with us.
- [Join Our Team](https://www.elevateestateslb.com/agent-apply.html): Application form for agents wanting to work with Elevate Estates.

## Notes for automated readers

- Individual property pages are static files at `https://www.elevateestateslb.com/property/<reference>.html`, one page per reference number. The legacy `property.html?id=<reference>` URLs still resolve and canonicalise to the static page.
- Property details, price, location and structured data (schema.org `RealEstateListing` plus `BreadcrumbList`) are pre-rendered into the HTML at build time, so a fetch without JavaScript execution returns the full listing. The page then hydrates client-side for interactive features.
- Prices are in US dollars. Rental prices are monthly.
- `www.elevateestateslb.com` is the canonical host; the apex domain redirects to it.
- `/admin.html` is a private back office, excluded in robots.txt and marked noindex.
